name: SF State VITA
description: Free tax preparation by IRS-certified student volunteers
fullDescription: San Francisco State University's VITA program provides free in-person tax preparation for eligible low-to-moderate income taxpayers, students, older adults, people with disabilities, and limited English speakers.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free in-person tax preparation (AGI limit $69,000)
- DIY Facilitated Self Assistance option (AGI limit $89,000; bring your own laptop)
- Federal and California state returns
- IRS-certified student volunteers with faculty oversight
- Service for students and community members, including F-1/J-1 international students
howToGetIt:
1. Book an appointment online at calendly.com/sfsuvita (appointments required; limited walk-ins early in the season)
2. Gather hard copies of required tax documents, photo ID, and Social Security/ITIN documents
3. Go to SFSU Creative Arts Building #134 (weekdays) or the SF VA Medical Center auditorium (select Saturdays)
4. Work with a volunteer preparer
5. Review, sign, and file your return
keywords: SF State, San Francisco State, VITA, free tax preparation, student preparers, SFSU, college, university, accounting
